attempts.text:
Plan summary: the only designated safe location is Tarkeshwar shelter, and the car makes two round trips from there. The first picks up the injured farmer and the two pupils at Dhunche (22 minutes). The second picks up four of the five adults at Gajuri farm (64 minutes). Deferring the fifth Gajuri adult (20) is cheaper than a third trip. Rescuing the three Gosaikunda adults would take 160 minutes of driving, so deferring them (60) is cheaper. The Trishuli–Nilkantha road is avoided because of the flooding.

<plan>
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter dhunche-village
load car1 injured 1
load car1 child 2
drive car1 dhunche-village tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 injured 1
unload car1 child 2
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter dhunche-village
drive car1 dhunche-village gajuri-farm
load car1 adult 4
drive car1 gajuri-farm dhunche-village
drive car1 dhunche-village tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 adult 4
defer gajuri-farm adult 1
defer gosaikunda-care-home adult 3
</plan>

COST: 166
